# Ogre chamber surfaces

shield-v1.png is an unchanged copy of the exact user-supplied transparent Shield.png; no redraw, filtering or recoloring. cobblestone-v1.png is the supplied 256x256 Ogre Floor.png, sampled as a repeating image with pixelated rendering and vertical compression for the chamber floor.

Red masonry is original SVG/code artwork in ogre-art.js, using Ogre Wall.jpg.webp as a palette/chipped-brick reference. The watermarked stock preview is not bundled, cropped or copied into the game. Chamber surfaces are separate from the maze gray-stone/green-floor palette.
